findings.claim: Q1 2026 10-Q：中東衝突造成全球地緣與總經擾動，直接衝擊中東及歐亞等旅遊走廊，取消增加、新訂單成長放緩。
findings.excerpt: The conflict in the Middle East has resulted in worldwide geopolitical and macroeconomic disruption, directly impacting travel trends in the Middle East and in other travel corridors such as Europe and Asia. Following the onset of the conflict, we experienced increased cancellations and slower growth in new bookings.

findings.claim: Q2 2026 10-Q：區域直接影響於 6 月大致正常化，但仍有間接影響（機票價格高、國際航線運能減少、長程需求下降）；Q3 10-Q 指長程需求疲弱仍壓低間夜成長。
findings.excerpt: Direct regional impacts largely normalized during June, there were continued indirect impacts, including elevated flight ticket prices, reduced flight capacity on certain international routes, and decreased long-haul international travel demand.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：硬體放在全球託管設施，災難復原計畫未必涵蓋所有區域；第三方服務商合約通常不提供服務中斷追索權。搜尋未見「單點失效」字樣或具名雲端供應商。

note: BKNG 為線上旅遊平台，無實體製造；未查到烏克蘭或台灣／中國曝險的具體揭露。僅 2 次搜尋。
